title: キャラはアニメ調、背景・商品（ドーナツ）は実写CM風のように要素ごとに画風を分けて指定してSNS広告向けの映像を作る
content:
キャラはアニメ調、背景・商品（ドーナツ）は実写CM風のように要素ごとに画風を分けて指定してSNS広告向けの映像を作る
SNS広告や商品PR・日常系の映像ならSeedance 2.0 Miniを使ってコストを抑えつつ十分なクオリティを狙い、激しいアクションや複雑モーションが必要な場合は上位モデルを使い分ける

en.content:
---
Create a video for SNS advertising by specifying different art styles for each element, such as anime-style characters and a live-action commercial style for the background and product (donuts). For SNS ads, product promotions, or everyday videos, use Seedance 2.0 Mini to keep costs down while aiming for sufficient quality. For intense action or complex motion, switch to a higher-end model.

--- THREAD CONTINUATION ---
[Thread 1] I tried making a similar video with Pollo 2.5 for comparison 🍩✨

It's not bad, but...
When you watch them side by side, you can immediately see the difference with Seedance 2.0 Mini 😂w

Especially in terms of lighting, texture, the naturalness of the camera work, and the overall richness of the video, Seedance 2.0 Mini seems to have a slight edge!

Moreover, it's great that Seedance 2.0 Mini is cost-effective✨

Of course, for works that require intense action or complex motion, there will be times when a higher-end model is needed, but for SNS ads, product promotions, or everyday videos, the quality is more than sufficient!

I think this comparison video conveys that difference 😊

Seedance 2.0 Mini...
This is really useful! 🔥
---
